Affiliate Disclosure

Last updated: June 1, 2026

In Plain English

Metabolic 40+ is a free resource for adults over 40 who want to optimize their health, metabolism, and energy. To keep the site running and the content free, some of the links on this site are affiliate links. This means if you click a product link and make a purchase, we may earn a small commission — at no extra cost to you.

Our Editorial Standards

Affiliate partnerships never influence the content of our articles, the products we recommend, or the way we describe ingredients and benefits. Every recommendation goes through the same evidence-based review process:

  • Ingredients and dosages are checked against peer-reviewed research
  • Manufacturing quality and third-party testing are verified
  • Customer reviews and complaints are analyzed for patterns
  • Money-back guarantees and return policies are confirmed
  • Pricing is compared against alternative products in the category

FTC Compliance

In accordance with the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC) Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255), Metabolic 40+ clearly discloses affiliate relationships on every page that contains affiliate links. We use the rel="sponsored nofollow" attribute on affiliate links and include visible disclosure notices on relevant articles.

Questions?

If you have any questions about our affiliate relationships or editorial policy, please don't hesitate to reach out. Transparency is a core value of this site.
